d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we look at the changing political landscape of Europe, where the far-right is gaining ground and centre-left governments are increasingly under pressure. From Italy and Germany to France and Britain, right-wing parties are reshaping European politics. We focus on Spain, where Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez faces mounting challenges over the housing crisis, immigration and economic inequality. With the People's Party (PP) leading the polls and the far-right Vox party emerging as a potential kingmaker, could Spain be heading…
